## Research interests

My work combines **assistive robotics** and **physical human-robot interaction**:
building real-time intent detection frameworks and assistive control systems from
multimodal sensing, validated in clinical settings. I am particularly interested in
physics-based modeling, model-based control, and multimodal AI for understanding
and predicting human motion.

::: {.chips}
<span class="chip">Wearable Robotics</span>
<span class="chip">Assistive Robotics</span>
<span class="chip">Physical Human-Robot Interaction</span>
<span class="chip">Multimodal Learning</span>
<span class="chip">Nonlinear Control</span>
:::
